name: Modify MAC address and SN.docx
path: SmartByte/暂时不用的/Modify MAC address and SN.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Plug the serial port cable into the device
Open the serial port tool, such as putty, secureCRT, and set the baud rate to 115200
Start the device
Enter the space bar to enter uboot
Execute the "print_p" command to print out the device MAC address, SN, hardware version number and other information.
Execute the burn MAC command
product_set ID SN MAC VER, the product model cannot be changed, SN, MAC, VER can be entered as needed
ID: product model, internal use, cannot be changed
MAC: MAC address
SN: A combination of letters and numbers, usually 12 digits
VER: Hardware version, supports letter and number combinations
product_set LTIE-MAC3L-8GT4XS4GS-6XRPC 202411060001 78:d0:64:66:9a:50 1.0
After the execution is completed, execute the print_p command again to check whether it is correct.
Modification of MAC is completed
